user.title: Configure heating control
user.description: Choose the temperature measurement and the heat-source switch for this zone. Safe timing defaults are applied automatically unless you open advanced settings.

data_description.zone_name: The user-facing name of the controlled area.
data_description.sensor_name: A user-facing name for this temperature measurement inside Controlel.
data_description.temperature_entity_id: The Home Assistant temperature entity used for control.
data_description.target_temperature: Heating is requested while the measured temperature is below this value.
data_description.heating_turn_on_differential: How far below target the room must fall before heating is requested.
data_description.heating_turn_off_differential: How far above target the room must rise before heating is stopped.
data_description.heat_demand_confirmation_duration_minute: How long the zone must continuously remain below its heating threshold before its request is passed to the heat source. Zero responds immediately. This filters brief drops, is separate from minimum-off time, resets on invalid or unavailable measurements, and does not detect an open window.
data_description.heat_source_control_mode: Use one normal switch, or choose custom services for an advanced installation.
data_description.controlled_entity_id: The switch Controlel turns on and off.
data_description.heat_delivery_mode: Leave zone delivery unmanaged or enable thermostat setpoint assist.
data_description.heat_delivery_actuator_entity_id: The climate entity whose technical target Controlel commands.
data_description.heat_delivery_ownership: Setpoint assist requires Controlel to own the actuator target.
data_description.heat_delivery_assist_policy: Choose whether confirmed heating demand selects the assist target.
data_description.heat_delivery_assist_target: Technical thermostat target while assist is active; this is not a valve position.
data_description.show_advanced: Set stable IDs, safety times, or other advanced values before creating the entry.

advanced.title: Advanced and safety settings
advanced.description: The recommended defaults are safe for most installations. Custom-service mode keeps enable and disable commands separate.

data.debug_until_changed: Keep Debug active until manually changed

data_description.sensor_id: A stable internal identifier generated automatically unless manually specified.
data_description.zone_id: A stable internal identifier generated automatically unless manually specified.
data_description.primary_measurement_max_age_minutes: How long the last sensor value may remain valid before Controlel treats it as stale.
data_description.max_future_skew: How much future timestamp error is tolerated before the measurement is rejected.
data_description.indeterminate_grace_period_minutes: How long Controlel preserves the current decision when the sensor becomes unknown, unavailable, invalid, or stale before applying the timeout action.
data_description.indeterminate_timeout_action: What Controlel does if valid measurement data does not return before the grace period expires.
data_description.minimum_heating_on_time_minutes: Shortest permitted run after an enable command is dispatched; this does not confirm physical boiler state.
data_description.minimum_heating_off_time_minutes: Shortest permitted idle period after a disable command is dispatched; this does not confirm physical boiler state.
data_description.diagnostic_profile: Controls presentation cadence, trace capacity, and logging detail only. Debug can update active countdown entities once per second and may increase Recorder database activity.
data_description.debug_duration_minutes: How long Debug remains active before returning to the previous profile, or Detailed when no previous profile is available.
data_description.debug_until_changed: Disable automatic Debug expiry. Debug then remains active until this option is changed manually.
data_description.enable_service_domain: Home Assistant service domain used when heating is required.
data_description.enable_service_name: Home Assistant service called when heating is required.
data_description.enable_target_entity_id: Entity targeted by the enable command.
data_description.disable_service_domain: Home Assistant service domain used when heating is not required.
data_description.disable_service_name: Home Assistant service called when heating is not required.
data_description.disable_target_entity_id: Entity targeted by the disable command.

error.invalid_zone_id: Use a lowercase letter first, followed only by lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores.

error.not_temperature_sensor: Select a sensor entity whose device class is temperature.

error.unsupported_temperature_unit: The temperature sensor must use Celsius or Fahrenheit.
